name: Lucian Cunningham
original_name: リュシアン・カニンガム
source:
[i]"Let's get along, 'honor student.'"[/i]

[i]Haughty Classmate[/i]

His father was a skilled Sylphid, and he's just as confident in his own abilities. He feels particularly antagonistic toward the “honor student" Leon, provoking him at any opportunity. He has no desire to cooperate with anyone.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=lucian]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
